summary: X363 is an exceptional execution of the scene spec. It masterfully handles the transition from enchantment to epistemic discovery. The erotic charge between Mara and Jonah is high but disciplined, functioning as a mode of perception rather than mere attraction. The 'turn'—Mara's internal control of her pulse to break the cue-channel—is dramatized with precision, teaching the intended practice without a detachable sermon. Character invariants are strictly maintained: Livia is skilled but acquisitive, Jonah is restrained and respectful, and Mara is formidable yet vulnerable.
